messages:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT P10042 — High error rate and region fallback oscillation affecting /v1/generate in eu-west-1 and eu-central-1. Paging ryan.sre, maria.prod. dashboard: https://redwood.ops/p10042 :rotating_light:
ryan.sre: oncall here. seeing 5xx spike ~12% over last 4m, p50 latency 1.1s, p95 ~3.2s. traces show repeated fallback hops between eu-west-1 and eu-central-1.
maria.prod: any immediate customer impact counts? which keys?
support-bot: Support alert: 27 API keys >10% error rate in last 10m; top hit: acct-acme-corp (20% of failures). Sending initial customer note.
ajay-ml: quick root cause note: canary model variant gpt-small-canary-v2 is throwing OOMs and 503s under longer contexts. Smart-routing policy for the route uses a sticky fallback with a region_preference tiebreaker that appears to send affinity back to the canary region. That creates a loop: fallback -> stable in other region, sticky affinity -> back to canary region where it fails.
ryan.sre: confirmed logs: 
```
[2026-03-15T15:34:56Z] model=gpt-small-canary-v2 status=OOM
[2026-03-15T15:35:01Z] routing: fallback to eu-central-1 (stable-v1) then sticky-affinity -> route back to eu-west-1 (gpt-small-canary-v2)
```
ryan.sre: loop matches error/latency spikes. looks like sticky TTL is long (600s) so affinity keeps bouncing.
nick-platform: I'm going to pause the rollout and pin the route to stable-v1 while we fix the policy. executing pause now.
maria.prod: please add a quick customer impact note to the incident page and flag SEV2; we'll prep outreach for affected customers.
nick-platform: ran commands: 
```
# pause rollout
redwood rollout pause --id rollout-20260315-42
# pin route to stable
redwood routing set-variant --route "/v1/generate" --variant stable-v1 --force
```
elaine-eng: proposing quick policy change rather than full remove: change fallback tie_breaker from region_preference to round_robin and reduce sticky TTL to 30s. That should break affinity loops while keeping some locality. I'll prepare the hotfix.
ajay-ml: agree. also bump canary memory or roll back canary binary; canary infra team should check container mem limits.
qa-jess: I'll run smoke against stable-v1 in eu-west and eu-central once pinned. ETA 3m.
support-bot: customer notifications queued for the 27 affected keys, template: "We're investigating increased errors on /v1/generate; mitigation in progress. We'll update in 30m"
ryan.sre: applying policy change now: 
```
redwood routing update --policy rollout-20260315-42 --fallback type=sticky tie_breaker=round_robin ttl=30
```
elaine-eng: hotfix created and applied. Also removing region_preference from policy matrix used by smart-routing.
ryan.sre: smoke checks from qa-jess show stable-v1 responding normally in both regions. error rate dropped to <1% within 90s of pin. p95 latency back to normal.
maria.prod: good — escalate notes: rollback canary and follow up with canary owner for memory fix. assign to ajay-ml and nick-platform.
ajay-ml: logging an action item to rollback canary tag and rerun preflight memory tests.
nick-platform: I've sent a postmortem placeholder and linked the rollout id. Also increased monitoring alert thresholds to avoid noisy flapping.
support-bot: Outreach sent to top 5 customers, general broadcast queued for others after postmortem.
on-official: thanks everyone — will monitor 20m and then update final.
oncall-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE P10042 — Mitigated: rollout paused, route pinned to stable-v1, fallback policy changed to avoid region_preference loops. Monitoring ongoing.
maria.prod: closing notes: SEV2 -> mitigated, follow-up: adjust canary resource limits, add policy lint to CI to disallow region_preference in sticky fallback. Assigning for next sprint. :white_check_mark:
